title: Munda Politics and Land: Understanding Indigeneity in Jharkhand, India
author: Pallavi Raonka

provider_scope.study_description: Provider abstract describes a fifteen-month ethnographic study from May 2017 to December 2018 focused on Munda politics, land, identity/representation, gender and Adivasi-State relations in Jharkhand.
provider_scope.scope_classification: Munda-specific ethnographic/political-land study; proposition-level use requires exact dissertation locators and methods/context review.
